title: Renewal Price — Alignment Services & Plans Month-Based Plans
content:
**Renewal price.** The renewal price of a Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan or Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan under Alignment Services & Plans is the line's plan price, plus a reinstatement charge of 20.00 when the renewal comes more than 30 calendar days after the expired plan's expiration date, rounded to the nearest cent. The plan price is that of the expired plan's line on the product's line card; the renewal takes the same line as the expired plan. The 30 days are counted in calendar days from the expiration date to the renewal date.

| Renewal date | Renewal price |
|---|---|
| no more than 30 calendar days after the expiration date | the line's plan price, to the cent |
| more than 30 calendar days after the expiration date | the line's plan price plus 20.00, to the cent |

### Worked figures (hypothetical line priced at 180.00 on a line card, expiration date 31 March)
| Renewal on | Days after expiry | Renewal price |
|---|---|---|
| 30 April | 30 | 180.00 |
| 1 May | 31 | 180.00 plus 20.00: 200.00 |
